This city… {{wi}}This country…{{wi}} It’s all falling apart…
If we do not do something fast, who knows what will happen later.
I have no other choice! Yeah, that’s right! I’m doing everyone a favor!
It’s a bad thing to do, but everyone will thank me later. They will understand…
Admin is just one guy, a small price to pay.
At first I didn’t understand DAK and why he would commit these atrocities, but now…
I’m done with being powerless, I’m taking matters into my own hands!
Big Daddy can go fuck himself! I’m done listening to his patronizing bullshit! To be honest, his ‘little one’ this, ‘little one’ that always pissed me off!
I’m done listening to everyone!
